build_CARAFEPack_upsampler: build a CARAFEPack module to perform content-aware feature upsampling with configurable kernel and scale factor
create_CARAFE_module: create a CARAFE module to reassemble features using provided masks with specified kernel and group size
create_CARAFENaive_module: create a CARAFENaive module to perform naive content-aware feature reassembly with given kernel and scale parameters
use_carafe_function: use the carafe function to upsample feature maps with content-aware reassembly masks and kernel parameters
use_carafe_naive_function: use the carafe_naive function to perform naive feature reassembly upsampling with provided masks and scale factor
